title: First repeat
prompt:
A game shows player names as they join a lobby. Write a function `first_repeat(names)` that returns the first name that has already appeared earlier in the list. If every name is different, return `None`.

For example, `first_repeat(["Ana", "Bo", "Cy", "Bo", "Ana"])` returns `"Bo"`, because `"Bo"` is the first name to show up a second time.

Use a set to remember the names you have seen.
hints: Start with `seen = set()` (not `{}`, which is a dictionary).
Inside a loop over `names`: if the name is `in seen`, return it; otherwise `add()` it.
